milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The player must navigate close to the chiseled red sandstone block at spawn-relative (4, 1, 4) and face toward it. max_distance=4 ensures the player has actually walked toward the target pillar (which is ~5.7 blocks from spawn), requiring intentional navigation rather than accidental facing from spawn. facing_tolerance=45 ensures the player is looking directly at the block and not at a nearby distractor pillar.
